next_step: DE-0010-R1 (code/tests/docs only, on top of the disabled safe baseline 63bb46d7957fbbd514f0b571564cb4a66da9d65b) closed two exact-head trust gaps found after DE-0010 merged and was then disabled pending review. (1) supervisor-verdicts.mjs's standalone ACCEPTED marker previously included the Markdown blockquote marker '>' in its harmless-decoration character class alongside bold/italic/heading markers, so a blockquoted/reply-quoted `> ACCEPTED — exact head <sha>` line - quoting someone else's comment, or the owner quoting a stale/rejected draft while discussing it - could be misread as a genuine acceptance. '>' is no longer part of that decoration class, so only a truly unquoted standalone marker line ever matches; a later genuine unquoted marker elsewhere in the same body is still honored. (2) supervisor-ci.mjs matched governance CI evidence by the fixed workflow name and file path alone, which proves which file path produced a run but not which content GitHub actually loaded from it when the run executed - a same-repository pull request can rewrite .github/workflows/project-governance.yml itself (GitHub loads a pull_request-triggered workflow's own YAML from the pull request's own ref, the same control-plane-loading gap that originally forced the autonomy wake/supervisor split) and still land a completed, successful, name+path-matching run at its own exact head. The new evaluateGovernanceEvidence/isGovernanceWorkflowFileTrusted functions additionally require the exact governance workflow file bytes at the pull request's head to match the repository's default-branch copy - read directly from the local checkout the supervisor's own workflow always makes of the default branch, not a separate spoofable round trip - before a run is ever reported as 'success'; a mismatched or unreadable comparison is reported as the new 'untrusted' conclusion, which supervisor-policy.mjs treats exactly like a CI failure (dispatches ci_failed, never merge_ready) regardless of any owner ACCEPTED verdict recorded at that same head. Both fixes are covered by new regression tests: blockquoted-acceptance rejection (with a later genuine unquoted marker in the same body still honored), a tampered-governance-workflow same-name/path 'success' run, an unreadable/stale default-branch comparison target, and a clean exact-head governance run still passing. Separately, the two workflow-file structural test suites (autonomy-wake-workflow.test.mjs, autonomy-supervisor-workflow.test.mjs) were failing with ENOENT on the disabled bootstrap head, because both DE-0010 workflow YAML files remain intentionally absent from every code-only branch pending review; they now use describe.skipIf to skip cleanly while the files are absent and will re-activate automatically once a maintainer reinstates the reviewed YAML - neither workflow file was restored, modified, merged, or live-tested by this work packet. Require a fresh exact-head Project governance run and independent owner/Codex review of this remediation before merge.
